description.name: ISPConfig Connect
description.tagline: Provision and manage ISPConfig 3 hosting accounts from WHMCS.
description.long: ISPConfig Connect provisions ISPConfig 3 clients, websites, FTP users, mail domains, DNS zones and databases over the ISPConfig remote JSON API, and manages the full service lifecycle (suspend, unsuspend, password change, package change, terminate) from WHMCS.
features: All-or-nothing account provisioning with automatic rollback
Client template and web server dropdowns loaded live from the panel
Actionable Test Connection diagnostics including missing API grants
Credential-scrubbed module logging of every API call
